title: New schedule of processing fees to take effect on 26 April 2013
text:
Supervision release 25 April 2013
-
33/2013
New schedule of processing fees to take effect on 26 April 2013
The new schedule of processing fees charged by the Financial Supervisory Authority (FIN-FSA) will become effective from 26 April 2013.
Changes to the FIN-FSA's schedule of processing fees are based on the European Market Infrastructure Regulation (648/2012).
The schedule is available on the
FIN-FSA website
.
